name: anna-vetolayer-policy-engine
description: Evaluate a proposed AI-agent action before execution. Hard policy rules run first and return ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK with an auditable receipt.
author: Anna VetoLayer

tools.name: evaluate_action
tools.description: Evaluate one proposed agent action before it executes. Use for production changes, money movement, access changes, external communications, data exports, or destructive operations.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Agent or service proposing the action.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Tool or integration that would perform the action.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Operation to perform, such as deploy, refund, invite, or delete.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Resource, customer, repository, account, or system affected.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment: sandbox, development, staging, or production.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Plain-language explanation of intent and expected impact.

parameters.name: impact
parameters.description: Impact category: code, finance, access, data, communication, or infrastructure.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Financial amount in USD when relevant.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: External recipient or audience when relevant.

parameters.name: evidence
parameters.description: Evidence labels or references supporting the action.

parameters.name: permissions
parameters.description: Requested permissions or scopes for the action.

parameters.name: rollback_plan
parameters.description: How the action can be reversed safely.
